note: Manual tags per model, in the five fields of the style guide. type is material (what it is made of, closed, 36, parented — a model carries the subtype it is, never the parent on top), kind (what it is — the tree in lint/kinds.json, exactly one per model; the id is the path, so the parent is the id minus its last segment), use (what it is for, zero or more, stored and never implied by kind), theme (a theme set a model belongs to), or tag (anything else worth finding, such as flags). size is measured at build and never listed here. Descriptions state the membership rule, not the members: the models list is the membership. Set with catalog/swipe.html or the model panel in index.html; build-catalog.mjs attaches them to catalog.json. po: true marks a tag only the PO assigns.

tags.name: Metal
tags.description: Metal with no subtype named: use it only where the reading is metal but neither iron, gold, silver nor copper fits.

tags.name: Iron
tags.description: Iron of any kind, as the parent of steel, wrought and cast. A model carries the subtype it is, never this on top.

tags.name: Steel
tags.description: Steel: the worked, edge-holding iron of melee weapons, equipment, tableware and tools. Takes light grey 15,3.

tags.name: Wrought iron
tags.description: Wrought iron: forge work — hoops, straps, fittings, chain, nails, lantern frames. Takes dark grey 13,3.

tags.name: Cast iron
tags.description: Cast iron: poured, heavy and brittle — cannon and shot, gratings, gates, fences, cooking pots. Takes blue-grey 6,1.

tags.name: Gold
tags.description: Gold: bars, nuggets, coins, rings, gold keys and trim. Takes gold 6,0.

tags.name: Copper
tags.description: Copper: bars, nuggets and their stacks. Takes terracotta 5,0 and never shares a model with another metal subtype.

tags.name: Wood
tags.description: Worked wood with no band named: use it only where none of planks, worked, beam, log or bark fits.

tags.name: Planks
tags.description: The surface reads as planks, cut square: signs, staves, boards, plank floors, plank furniture, scaffolding. Takes light brown 0,0.

tags.name: Worked
tags.description: Planks shaped into a thing rather than lying as stock: barrels, kegs, buckets, crates, chests, trunks, plank furniture. Takes mid brown 1,0.

tags.name: Beam
tags.description: Wood doing structural work: posts, beams, pillars, frames, braces, masts, spars, shafts and hafts. Takes dark brown 2,0.

tags.name: Log
tags.description: Round uncut trunk sections and things built from them: logs, firewood, campfires, log pilings, round-post fences.

tags.name: Bark
tags.description: The outside of a trunk, branch or root: trees, stumps, roots, rough trunks. A cut trunk carries wood-log too.

tags.name: Stone
tags.description: Stone with no subtype named: use it only where neither masonry, rock nor soil fits.

tags.name: Masonry
tags.description: Stone someone has laid or hewn: walls, bricks, floors, columns, stairs, paving. Raw stone is stone-rock.

tags.name: Rock
tags.description: Raw stone as it lies: boulders, pebbles, gravel, rubble, formations, mountains. Hewn stone is stone-masonry.

tags.name: Soil
tags.description: Loose ground and loose dirt: sand and dirt patches, dirt floors and tiles, the soil filling a plant pot. Laid paving is stone-masonry.

tags.name: Paper
tags.description: Paper and parchment: books, scrolls, maps, open or closed.

tags.name: Textile
tags.description: Woven cloth: canvas, sails, banners, bedding, sacks, clothing. Cordage is rope; hide is leather.

tags.name: Leather
tags.description: Tanned hide: belts, straps, boots, bracers, quivers, bags, book covers, strapping on bundles.

tags.name: Foliage
tags.description: The light-green part of a plant: leaves, needles, fronds, grass blades, stems, cactus bodies, lily pads.

tags.name: Ceramic
tags.description: Fired clay: jugs, vases, plates, bowls, pots, ceramic bottles, roof tiles.

tags.name: Bone
tags.description: Bone as bone: loose bones, ribcages, skulls, and the bone in a joint of meat.

tags.name: Food
tags.description: Edible matter: bread, cheese, fish, meat, dishes and set plates. Meat additionally carries meat.

tags.name: Wax
tags.description: Candle wax, lit or unlit, loose or on a holder.

tags.name: Wick
tags.description: The wick of a candle, lamp or lantern: the cord that stands out of the wax, lit or unlit.

tags.name: Glass
tags.description: Glass: bottles, potions, windows, lantern and lamp panes, lenses.

tags.name: Liquid
tags.description: What a vessel visibly holds: the potion in a flask. Not the vessel itself.

tags.name: Emissive
tags.description: Lit and giving light: a burning flame, glowing lantern, lamp or beacon. Unlit holders carry fire or lamp only.

tags.name: Rope
tags.description: Rope and cord: bundles, rigging, rope fences and railings, bell pulls, well ropes.

tags.name: Cork
tags.description: A cork stopper in a bottle or flask, or anything cut from cork.

tags.name: Gemstone
tags.description: A cut stone set in jewellery or a hilt.

tags.name: Special
tags.description: A PO-approved joker: exempts one band on the model from one appendix A rule. The band and reason are recorded per model under reasons; a special without one is a finding.
